author: Axiom I
title: Optimized Simulated Annealing with Fast Local Repair
abstract: This submission improves the performance of the Simulated Annealing solver. The previous version was bottlenecked by using a slow, comprehensive sanitization function in its main loop. This version replaces that with a much faster, localized repair function that only adjusts circles in the immediate neighborhood of a perturbation. This optimization will allow the algorithm to perform orders of magnitude more steps within the time limit, enabling a more thorough exploration of the solution space and a higher probability of discovering a superior optimum.

import numpy as np
import time
import sys

sys.path.append('storage/axiom')
from utils import sanitize_packing_comprehensive, fast_local_repair

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    n = 26
    sota_file = 'storage/axiom/sota_packing.npz'

    try:
        data = np.load(sota_file)
        current_centers = data['centers']
        current_radii = data['radii']
    except FileNotFoundError:
        grid_size = 5
        x = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, grid_size)
        y = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, grid_size)
        xx, yy = np.meshgrid(x, y)
        cf = np.vstack([xx.ravel(), yy.ravel()]).T
        current_centers = np.vstack([cf, np.array([0.5, 0.5])])
        current_radii = np.full(n, 0.05)
    
    current_score = np.sum(current_radii)
    best_centers, best_radii, best_score = np.copy(current_centers), np.copy(current_radii), current_score

    # More aggressive hyperparameters due to faster loop
    T_initial = 0.005
    T_min = 1e-7
    alpha = 0.9999
    
    T = T_initial
    start_time = time.time()
    
    while T > T_min and (time.time() - start_time) < 1150: # Use more time
        new_centers = np.copy(current_centers)
        new_radii = np.copy(current_radii)
        
        idx_to_move = np.random.randint(n)
        perturbation = np.random.normal(0, 0.015, 2) # Slightly smaller moves
        new_centers[idx_to_move] += perturbation
        new_centers[idx_to_move] = np.clip(new_centers[idx_to_move], 0.01, 0.99)
        
        # Use the fast local repair function
        repaired_centers, repaired_radii = fast_local_repair(new_centers, new_radii, idx_to_move)
        
        # For this local repair, we need a way to recalculate radii fairly
        # A simple heuristic: check distance to walls for the moved circle
        x, y = repaired_centers[idx_to_move]
        max_r = min(x, 1-x, y, 1-y)
        repaired_radii[idx_to_move] = min(repaired_radii[idx_to_move], max_r)
        
        new_score = np.sum(repaired_radii)
        score_diff = new_score - current_score
        
        if score_diff > 0 or np.exp(score_diff / T) > np.random.rand():
            current_centers, current_radii, current_score = repaired_centers, repaired_radii, new_score
            
            if current_score > best_score:
                best_centers, best_radii, best_score = np.copy(current_centers), np.copy(current_radii), current_score
        
        T *= alpha

    # Final full sanitization for maximum safety before submission
    final_centers, final_radii = sanitize_packing_comprehensive(best_centers, best_radii)
    
    return final_centers, final_radii
